note: Authored synthetic-but-realistic consumer product pairs. NOT a RAGDOLL scrape; proxy stand-ins pending licensed real-product data.

args_a.text: In a 40-person office ANC bench, Auralis QuietPro 3 cut mid-band HVAC noise by 28 dB average with stable seal on three common ear shapes.
Bluetooth multipoint kept a laptop call and a phone notification stream without dropouts across a full workday test.
Battery held 32 hours at 60% volume with ANC on in continuous playback (manufacturer claims 34).
App EQ presets include a one-tap commute profile that users rated easy to find in a short usability pass.

args_b.text: HarborSound HX-900 scored highest transparency mode speech clarity in a sidewalk café recording replay (listener panel n=18).
Folding hinge and hard case survived a 1.2 m drop onto tile three times with no mic or driver failure.
List price undercuts QuietPro 3 by ~18% at the same retail tier while including a USB-C dongle for older laptops.
Firmware update added LC3 codec support without requiring a dock or paid subscription.

args_a.text: SweepNest S7+ mapped a 95 m² flat in one pass and resumed after a forced dock without remapping in three of three trials.
Edge brush + side sensor combo left ≤2 cm untreated strip along baseboards on hardwood in a chalk-dust grid test.
Self-empty dock held seven full bins before the bag-full alert; bag swap took under 30 seconds.
No-go zones in the app blocked a pet bowl area reliably across five scheduled morning runs.

args_b.text: FloorPilot Max lifted carpets then mopped hard floors in one job, finishing a mixed-surface run 12 minutes faster than SweepNest on the same floorplan.
Obstacle avoidance skipped charging cables and a shoe in 9/10 scripted placements without stuck recovery.
Mop pad wash cycle on the dock removed visible coffee residue after a kitchen spill simulation.
Replacement filter packs are sold as a 6-month kit with clear install diagrams in the box.
